solutions.fullSolution: Substituting g(x)=2x into f: f(x)=3x+2(2x)=7x. df/dx=7.

criteria.description: Correctly applies the forward-mode formula to get df/dx=7.

solutions.fullSolution: dg/dx = 2. df/dx = (partial f/partial x)(dx/dx) + (partial f/partial g)(dg/dx) = 3(1)+2(2) = 3+4 = 7. Matches the direct total derivative.

criteria.description: Correctly applies the backward-mode formula to get df/dx=7.

solutions.fullSolution: df/dg = partial f/partial g = 2 (g's only child is f). df/dx = (df/df)(partial f/partial x) + (df/dg)(partial g/partial x) = 1(3)+2(2) = 3+4 = 7. Matches both previous answers.
dx/dz = 1,000,000/1 = 1,000,000. Forward mode would be roughly a million times more expensive than backward mode for this network.
